description: Convert a whole number of any size (BigInt) between bases 2–36: binary, octal, decimal, hex, base 36 or any other. Input base can be auto-detected from 0x / 0b / 0o prefixes; spaces, _ and , separators are ignored; negatives OK. Also shows bit length and the two's complement view (signed/unsigned value, hex, bits) at 8/16/32/64 bits, and whether it fits. Fractions are not supported (same as the website). Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/base-convert/

group.description: Group digits like the website (binary/hex by 4, octal by 3, decimal with commas).

width.description: Bit width for the two's complement view.

name: base_convert
title: Number base convert
